description: This file defines a template class 'MessageDataBufferType' within the 'WPEFramework::Messaging' namespace. It manages inter-process communication buffers, including a nested 'DataBuffer' class that handles cyclic buffers with doorbell signaling for synchronization. The class provides methods for pushing and popping data, waiting for signals, and managing buffer lifecycle, with configuration based on filenames and socket ports.

classes.name: MessageDataBufferType
classes.description: A template class managing message buffers with synchronization mechanisms, supporting data push/pop, waiting, and buffer lifecycle management.

classes.name: DataBuffer
classes.description: A nested class within 'MessageDataBufferType' that extends 'Core::CyclicBuffer' to add doorbell signaling and buffer management functionalities.

methods.name: PrepareFilenames
methods.description: Static method to generate filenames for buffer files based on directory, identifier, instance ID, and socket port.

methods.name: PushData
methods.description: Method to write data into the cyclic buffer, including size header, and ring the doorbell.

methods.name: PopData
methods.description: Method to read data from the buffer after doorbell signal, handling partial reads and errors.

methods.name: Ring
methods.description: Method to signal data availability via doorbell.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Method to wait for a doorbell signal with a specified timeout.

methods.name: FlushDataBuffer
methods.description: Method to flush the buffer contents.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid.
